run_strip_asm_cli: run the strip_asm.py script to clean an input assembly file and write the stripped output
process_asm_strip_directives: process an assembly string to strip unwanted directives, comments, and global declarations
transform_labels_remove_unused: transform assembly labels by normalizing and removing unused local label declarations
process_identifiers_normalize_macho: process identifiers in an assembly line to normalize MachO underscores for cross-platform consistency
find_used_labels_jumps: find all used local labels referenced by jump instructions in assembly text
